name: Asenath
description: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: In the video Price points to Joseph marrying an Egyptian woman. Pharaoh gave Joseph Asenath, the daughter of Potipherah priest of On, and she bare him Manasseh and Ephraim before the years of famine came.

note.label: The Religious Peer Pressure of Fred Price Jr

points: He gave him to wife Asenath, the daughter of Potipherah priest of On. Could he marry an Israelite? There were no other Israelites there.

Pharaoh called Joseph's name Zaphnathpaaneah and gave him Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On to wife. These heathens always like to change our names; that is one reason America is called spiritual Egypt, because they do the same thing that ancient Egypt did.

note.label: Genesis 41: Pharaoh's Dreams and Joseph's Rise Over Egypt
